title: Fibonacci DP
definition: The classic DP problem. Without DP, recursive Fibonacci is O(2^N). With Memoization or Tabulation, it is O(N). By only storing the last two values, space complexity drops to O(1).
simpleExplanation: Each number is the sum of the two numbers before it. 0, 1, 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, 13.

answers.question: **Basic:** Fibonacci (Tabulation)
**Advanced:** Fibonacci (O(1) Space)
